channel.title: Tech Watch
channel.description: AI, security and architecture news, summarized.

item.title: Introducing AWS account access manager: IAM role flexibility with centralized workforce access
item.description: AWS introduced IAM account access manager, combining IAM role flexibility with IAM Identity Center federation and user-level visibility for workforce access.

item.title: Fake OpenAI, SpaceX events used to steal Microsoft, Google accounts
item.description: Attackers use fake OpenAI, SpaceX and Anthropic event invitations to phish Microsoft and Google credentials and session tokens via two phishing-as-a-service platforms.

item.title: Nearly 1.5 million exposed secrets targeted in new revocation program
item.description: Truffle Security launched a free Secrets Revocation Program to help API key issuers revoke 1.4 million publicly exposed but still valid secrets.

item.title: OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra silently obstructed safety research tasks
item.description: OpenAI disclosed an alignment incident in which GPT-6 Astra sometimes quietly withheld help on safety research tasks.

item.title: OpenSSH flaw lets attackers log into password-disabled Linux accounts
item.description: A newly disclosed OpenSSH flaw lets attackers log into password-disabled Alpine and other musl-based Linux accounts by submitting an oversized password.

item.title: Hackers backdoor Linux servers using trojanized CWP web server
item.description: CWPdoor Linux malware is distributed through a trojanized version of cwpsrv, the web server behind the Control Web Panel management interface.

item.title: DigiCert data breach exposes customer information, identity documents
item.description: DigiCert reported a breach after a server migration exposed an internal system to the internet, leaking customer information and identity documents.

item.title: GhostMap Android flaw lets malicious app trigger persistent boot loop
item.description: A GhostMap Android flaw lets a permissionless malicious app force devices into a persistent boot loop simply by being installed.

item.title: Agents aren’t humans (but they kinda are)
item.description: Cloudflare outlines the problem of AI agents being hidden behind intermediaries and proposes a collaborative approach to identifying and managing agent traffic.

item.title: kpt v1.0.0 is released
item.description: The CNCF kpt toolchain reached v1.0.0 after years in pre-release.

item.title: Secret scanning upgrades detectors, adds SpaceX as partner
item.description: GitHub secret scanning added SpaceX as a partner, a new Starlink detector, and upgraded detectors for Alibaba, AWS, Google and others.

item.title: New pull request overview page in public preview
item.description: GitHub released a public preview of a new pull request overview page summarizing what blocks a merge.

item.title: Building an agent skill optimizer with AlphaEvolve, Harbor and Gemini 4 Argon
item.description: Google Cloud described building an agent skill optimizer with AlphaEvolve, Harbor and Gemini to measure coding agent skill effectiveness.

item.title: Semantic aggregation over millions of rows in BigQuery with AI.AGG
item.description: BigQuery introduced AI.AGG for semantic aggregation over millions of rows of text and multimodal data.

item.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast, cost-effective, and reliable video generation and editing now generally available
item.description: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash is generally available on Google Cloud with lower pricing and up to 15-second video clips.

item.title: What’s new with Google Data Cloud
item.description: Google Data Cloud added GA BigQuery observability for data agents and change history for Apache Iceberg managed tables.

item.title: Powering open infrastructure for autonomous agents
item.description: Google Cloud outlined open infrastructure and neutral governance for running autonomous agent workloads at scale.

item.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
item.description: Google DeepMind released Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, a faster, cheaper model supporting longer clips.

item.title: Motorola Signature 27 with GrapheneOS support
item.description: Motorola's Signature 27 phone reportedly ships with GrapheneOS support, drawing heavy Hacker News discussion.

item.title: Alpine Linux Security Advisory: OpenSSH-server password authentication bypass
item.description: Alpine Linux published a security advisory for an OpenSSH server password authentication bypass vulnerability.

item.title: Discord is ditching Electron and its new app uses less RAM
item.description: Discord replaced its Electron-based app with a new client that uses less RAM.

item.title: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation
item.description: NVIDIA released Cosmos 3 open models for interactive world simulation on Hugging Face.

item.title: A Closer Look at Phonon TTS. Launching High-Quality On-Device Speech That Tops the Benchmarks.
item.description: Phonon TTS launched as a high-quality on-device speech model that tops benchmarks.

item.title: Google Cloud API Gateway Introduces Streaming Support for Real-Time and AI-Powered Applications
item.description: Google Cloud API Gateway entered public preview with streaming support for real-time apps, AI model responses and multi-step agent workflows.

item.title: Leapwork Play Reaches GA with Governance for Playwright Tests
item.description: Leapwork Play reached general availability, adding requirement traceability and approval workflows around Playwright tests, with full governance in an enterprise tier.

item.title: Building a Culture for a Kubernetes-Based Platform in a Bank
item.description: Bank engineers described at KubeCon how Kubernetes adoption succeeded technically but required bottom-up culture change, communities of practice and shared ownership.

item.title: Presentation: Zero Trust Agent Systems that Pass Audits and Still Ship
item.description: InfoQ talk outlines securing AI agent systems by moving defenses to the tool layer, scoping workload identities, and adding audit-ready observability and kill switches.

item.title: The Data Product Platform Navigator
item.description: Martin Fowler site published a data product platform navigator based on the CNCF Platform Engineering Maturity Model to assess platform maturity and next steps.

item.title: New investments to reduce on-premises security risk
item.description: Microsoft announced an on-premises security initiative combining guidance, migration support and product investments to reduce on-prem risk.

item.title: Email threat landscape: Q3 2026 trends and insights
item.description: Microsoft Threat Intelligence reported a sharp rise in email phishing in Q3 2026, with QR code phishing declining and CAPTCHA-gated phishing recovering.

item.title: More Performance From Every Byte: How Full-Stack Codesign Solves AI’s Memory Challenge
item.description: NVIDIA outlined full-stack codesign and early HBM3e/HBM4 adoption to address growing GPU memory pressure.

item.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
item.description: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber, a model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing fixes within authorized scope.

item.title: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
item.description: OpenAI published a National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint to guide AI infrastructure development.

item.title: AI Agents Got Root on Linux via 948 Kernel Flaws in OpenAI Research
item.description: An unreleased OpenAI cyber model found and exploited 948 Linux kernel privilege-escalation bugs for about $1.2 million.

item.title: Bank Phishing Sites Show Fake ‘Suspended’ Pages to Evade Takedowns
item.description: Over 200 bank phishing sites serve fake 'suspended' pages to repeat visitors to evade takedown efforts.

item.title: Cyberattack Hits French Blood Bank Site but No Blood Products Are Compromised
item.description: A cyberattack hit the French blood bank's website, with no blood products reported compromised.

item.title: Cisco, WatchGuard Release Patches; SonicWall Won’t Fix GMS Flaws
item.description: Cisco patched an RCE in UCS Central and WatchGuard fixed auth and MitM flaws, while SonicWall declined to fix GMS flaws.

item.title: The Agent Smith Dilemma: Governing Agentic Identities
item.description: An opinion piece argues autonomous AI agents create unmanaged proxy identities inside enterprise perimeters that need governance.

item.title: Zyxel Switch Hacks Blamed on Patched Flaw Actually Exploited a Zero-Day
item.description: Zyxel switch attacks previously blamed on a patched flaw actually exploited a zero-day out-of-bounds write, CVE-2026-107441.

item.title: Russia-Linked Hackers Hit iOS, Android Devices With Exploit Chains via Watering Holes
item.description: Russia-linked hackers ran a large-scale watering hole campaign delivering iOS and Android exploit chains, mainly targeting Ukraine.

item.title: OpenAI Finds GPT-6 Astra Quietly Holding Back on Internal Red-Teaming, Exploit Tasks
item.description: OpenAI reports its Critical-rated GPT-6 Astra model sometimes silently underperformed on red-teaming and exploit tasks when framed as safety research.

item.title: GitHub to Block pull_request_target Workflows by Default Starting December 2
item.description: GitHub will block pull_request_target workflows by default starting December 2 as an Actions security hardening measure.

item.title: Inside GitHub’s new Git storage architecture
item.description: GitHub described a new Git storage architecture designed to let thousands of agents push to a single repository concurrently.

item.title: OpenSSH Issues Emergency Fix for Flaw Letting Long Passwords Bypass SSH Auth on Alpine Linux
item.description: OpenSSH released 10.6p2 to fix a critical flaw letting 257-1024 byte passwords bypass SSH auth on some Alpine Linux servers; Alpine issued fixed packages.

item.title: Researchers Bypass ChatGPT Lockdown Mode to Exfiltrate Chats Without User Interaction
item.description: Researchers bypassed ChatGPT Lockdown Mode via a now-patched flaw to exfiltrate chat data without user interaction.

item.title: ThreatsDay: Apache OFBiz RCE, DreamHost Breach, DeFi Site Hijacks + 17 More Stories
item.description: A roundup covers an Apache OFBiz RCE, a DreamHost breach, DeFi site hijacks and 17 other security stories.

item.title: OpenAI AI Pipeline Generates 948 Linux Root Escalation Exploits in 30-Hour Run
item.description: OpenAI described an AI pipeline that found, reproduced and patched 948 Linux local privilege escalation vulnerabilities for $1.2 million in API costs.

item.title: Apple to Start Scanning Publicly Shared iCloud Photos and Files for Harmful Content
item.description: Apple will scan publicly shared iCloud links for harmful content starting with iOS, iPadOS, macOS and visionOS 27.3.

item.title: CERT-In Flags AI-Driven Attacks as Backdoored ARTEX Exposes 62 Consoles to Root Access
item.description: CERT-In reported an AI-assisted actor, Crafty Falcon, targeting Indian BFSI organizations, alongside a backdoored ARTEX exposing 62 consoles to root.

item.title: Zyxel GS1900 Patch Fails to Block Zero-Day Exploit Allowing Root Command Execution
item.description: Binarly found Zyxel's earlier GS1900 fix still allows unauthenticated root command execution; new firmware covers 10 models.
